logs.subject: Why most PI firm AI stalls
logs.body_excerpt:
Hi Robert,

I wrote something you may appreciate as a founding partner: most AI projects in PI firms fail not because the tools are weak, but because they get added to a workflow that was never redesigned in the first place.
